name: marketplace-authoring
description: Centralize Codex and Claude skills in the Suarja marketplace with correct plugin routing, manifests, provenance, validation, publication, and cache refresh.

interface.longDescription: A repeatable workflow for routing a new skill to the right plugin, maintaining Codex and Claude manifests, preserving provenance, validating the package, publishing it, and refreshing the installed marketplace cache.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use the marketplace authoring recipe to add this skill to the correct plugin and central marketplace.
